title: Tamsin and the Smile
author: Paloma Okafor
blurb: Ulyana Montrose, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
